title: androsace subulifera
intro: Androsace subulifera, commonly known as Rock Jasmine, is a plant species belonging to the Primulaceae family. It is used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its potential to help lower blood pressure, reduce inflammation, and alleviate symptoms of respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Rock Jasmine include its anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antioxidant properties, which may contribute to its ability to soothe wounds and reduce the risk of infection. The bioactive constituents of Rock Jasmine include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which are believed to be responsible for its medicinal properties.
